Diamond or good iron with enchantments; food with Comfort; a way home.$(br2)$(bold)Ferrous Wroughtnaut$() holds $(bold)Trains$() (Steam 'n' Rails).$(br)$(bold)Naga$() holds $(bold)Ships$().$(br)$(bold)The Invoker$() holds the $(bold)Trading Floor$().$(br)$(bold)Umvuthi$() holds $(bold)Diesel$().$(br)$(bold)Elder Guardians$() hold $(bold)Diving$().$(br)$(bold)Frostmaw$() holds $(bold)Climate control$(); $(bold)Torte$() (Nether) $(bold)Advanced cooking$().

Trains and ships are the two ways to move ore between regions that do not involve a horse. Diesel is the engine that does not need a river. The Trading Floor is the market that runs without you.$(br2)The Invoker's ledgers also turn up on the totem captains. Tier 2 is where a server's economy stops being one person's chest.
